title: Digital Arrest / Fake Police Video Call
signals: Caller claims to be CBI/NCB/police and keeps you on a video call for hours
Shows a fake 'arrest warrant' or 'court order' on screen
Threatens that your account will be frozen unless you pay 'verification money'
Never lets you talk to family or disconnect the call

explanation.en: No Indian agency arrests anyone over a video call. 'Digital arrest' is a made-up concept used only by scammers. Real police contact you in person with written documents.
explanation.hi: भारत में किसी को वीडियो कॉल पर गिरफ्तार नहीं किया जाता। 'डिजिटल अरेस्ट' एक झूठी कहानी है जो सिर्फ ठग गढ़ते हैं। असली पुलिस लिखित कागज़ात के साथ सामने आती है।
explanation.mr: भारतात कोणालाही व्हिडिओ कॉलवर अटक केली जात नाही. 'डिजिटल अरेस्ट' ही फक्त उगाच बनवलेली संकल्पना आहे. खरी पोलिस लेखी कागदपत्रांसह समोर येते.

do: If a real officer visits, ask for ID and insist on the station
dont: Never stay on the call
Never pay for 'verification'
Never share OTP or bank details
Never install any app they send

title: Fake KYC / Account Block Message
signals: SMS/WhatsApp says your KYC or Aadhaar will be suspended today
Shortened or misspelled link like sbi-kyc-verify.xyz
Asks for OTP, PIN or card number to 'reactivate' the account
Threatens permanent block if you don't act in minutes

explanation.en: Banks never ask you to update KYC through SMS links or WhatsApp. The link opens a fake site that copies your credentials in seconds.
explanation.hi: बैंक कभी SMS या WhatsApp लिंक से KYC अपडेट नहीं मांगते। लिंक खोलते ही आपकी जानकारी ठगों के पास पहुँच जाती है।
explanation.mr: बँक कधीही SMS किंवा WhatsApp लिंकद्वारे KYC अपडेट मागत नाही. लिंक उघडताच तुमची माहिती उगाच्यांका जाते.

do: Open your bank's official app or website yourself
Call the number on the back of your card
dont: Never click the link
Never enter OTP on a page someone sent you
Never share card number/CVV

title: UPI Collect Request / Refund Trick
signals: A request to 'approve' a payment to RECEIVE money - UPI works the opposite way
Asks to pay Re 1 or scan a QR code to 'unlock a refund'
Fake customer-care number from a search result or WhatsApp profile
Wants you to read out the 6-digit UPI PIN

explanation.en: In UPI, approving a collect request SENDS money from your account. QR codes and UPI PINs are only for paying, never for receiving refunds.
explanation.hi: UPI में कोई भी request approve करने का मतलब है पैसा भेजना। QR कोड और UPI PIN सिर्फ पैसे देने के लिए है, रिफंड पाने के लिए नहीं।
explanation.mr: UPI मध्ये कोणतीही request मान्य केली की पैसे जातात. QR कोड आणि UPI PIN फक्त पैसे देण्यासाठी आहेत, पैसे मिळवण्यासाठी नाही.

do: Reject every collect request you don't expect
Use only the official customer-care number inside the app
dont: Never approve a request to 'receive' money
Never share UPI PIN or OTP
Never scan a QR to get a refund

title: Fake Job / Work-From-Home Offer
signals: Unsolicited offer with high pay for simple work
Asks for registration fee, training fee or 'joining kit' money
Payment only in crypto, gift cards or UPI to a personal account
No interview, no company email domain (gmail/yahoo address)

explanation.en: Real employers never ask candidates to pay money to get a job. The 'fee' is the product - once you pay, the recruiter disappears.
explanation.hi: असली नौकरी में कभी कंपनी उम्मीदवार से फ़ीस नहीं लेती। भर्तीकर्ता पैसे लेकर गायब हो जाता है।
explanation.mr: खरी नोकरीमध्ये कंपनी उमेदवाराकडून फी मागत नाही. पैसे घेतल्यावर भरती करणारा गायब होतो.

do: Verify the company on its official website
dont: Never pay to get a job
Never share ID documents with unknown recruiters
Never accept payment only in crypto/gift cards

title: Lottery / Prize Money Scam
signals: You 'won' a draw you never entered
Asks for processing fee, GST or insurance amount before releasing prize
WhatsApp number instead of an official website
Deadline to claim within 24 hours

explanation.en: You cannot win a lottery you never played. The 'fee' you pay to release the prize is the entire scam.
explanation.hi: जिस लॉटरी में आपने भाग नहीं लिया, वह कैसे जीत सकते हैं? 'फ़ीस' देने के बाद इनाम कभी नहीं मिलता।
explanation.mr: ज्या लॉटरीत तुम्ही सहभाग घेतला नाही ती कसे जिंकता येईल? 'फी' दिल्यावर इनाम कधीही मिळत नाही.

do: Tell elders in the house it is fake
dont: Never pay any fee to claim a prize
Never share ID or bank details to 'verify winner'

title: Sextortion / Edited Video Blackmail
signals: Stranger befriends you on social media and moves the chat to WhatsApp
Requests an intimate video call, then says it was 'recorded'
Threatens to send the video to your family and contacts unless you pay
Demands repeated payments - the blackmail never ends

explanation.en: Paying never stops sextortion; it only identifies you as someone who will pay more. The 'video' is usually recorded from a clip or edited. Block, report, and go to the police or 1930.
explanation.hi: पैसे देने से ब्लैकमेल बंद नहीं होता, बल्कि वे और मांगते रहते हैं। रुकें, ब्लॉक करें और 1930 या पुलिस के पास जाएँ।
explanation.mr: पैसे दिल्याने ब्लॅकमेल थांबत नाही, ते अजून मागत राहतात. थांबा, ब्लॉक करा आणि 1930 किंवा पोलिसांकडे जा.

do: Report the profile to the social network
Talk to family or a counsellor immediately
dont: Never pay - it never ends
Never send more media
Never delete evidence (save screenshots)

title: Electricity / Gas Disconnection Notice
signals: SMS says power will be disconnected tonight for unpaid bill
Asks to pay via a personal UPI ID or unknown link
Fake 'smart meter recharge' message
Threatens disconnection within hours

explanation.en: Disconnection notices come through the official utility channel, never via a random SMS with a payment link to a personal UPI ID.
explanation.hi: कटौती की नोटिस आधिकारिक विभाग से आती है, किसी अनजान लिंक या निजी UPI से नहीं।
explanation.mr: वीजतडीचा नोटिस अधिकृत विभागाकडून येतो, कोणत्याही अनोळखी लिंक किंवा वैयक्तिक UPI कडून नाही.

do: Check your real bill in the official app
Pay through the official website/app only
dont: Never pay a personal UPI ID for utilities
Never click SMS links to pay bills

title: Fake Parcel / Customs Seizure
signals: Call or SMS says your parcel is held for illegal contents
Caller claims to be customs or a courier and demands a clearance fee
Threatens arrest if you don't pay quickly
Asks you to share ID documents to 'clear' the parcel

explanation.en: Customs and couriers do not demand fees by phone or ask for ID on WhatsApp. This story exists only to scare you into paying.
explanation.hi: कस्टम्स या कूरियर फ़ोन पर फ़ीस नहीं माँगते और WhatsApp पर ID नहीं माँगते। यह डरा कर पैसे ऐँठने की कहानी है।
explanation.mr: कस्टम्स किंवा कुरियर फोनवर फी मागत नाही आणि WhatsApp वर ID मागत नाही. ही घाबरवून पैसे काढण्याची कथा आहे.

do: Track any real shipment on the official courier site
dont: Never pay a 'clearance fee' by phone
Never share ID scans on WhatsApp

title: Instant Loan / Fee-Fraud
signals: Guaranteed loan without documents or credit checks
Asks for processing fee / GST / insurance before disbursement
Loan apps that need full contact-list and gallery access
Threatens to morph your photos if you don't pay 'EMI'

explanation.en: Legitimate lenders deduct fees from the loan, never demand them upfront. Rogue loan apps then blackmail you with your contacts and photos.
explanation.hi: असली ऋणदाता फ़ीस ऋण से काटते हैं, पहले नहीं माँगते। नकली ऐप फिर आपकी फ़ोटो और contacts से ब्लैकमेल करते हैं।
explanation.mr: खरे कर्जदार फी कर्जातून कापतात, आधी मागत नाहीत. बनावट ॲप फोटो व संपर्कांच्या आधारे ब्लॅकमेल करतात.

do: Check the app's permissions and reviews
dont: Never pay fees before a loan is disbursed
Never grant contact/gallery access to loan apps
